arguments.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t INNER JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
arguments.explanation: Returns the fraud rate as a fraction across all labelled transactions. It is the share of labelled transactions that are marked as fraud.
assumptions: About a third of transactions have no fraud label. They are unknown, not legitimate, so the rate is computed over labelled transactions only, not over all transactions.
The result is a fraction between 0 and 1; multiply by 100 to read it as a percentage.
The full date range of the data is included (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31).
